view.governing_question: What is the most complete account of this black-box component, given only that 'a' is answered '0' and 'b' is answered '0'?
view.closure_assumption: The finite observation list is treated as the complete account of the component; this closure is WITHDRAWN, because a two-observation record does not fix the reply on any longer or unattempted input word.
view.polar_view: Read the reply not as a lookup over the two seen words but as the output of a state-carrying process whose reply to the next symbol depends on the history so far; the two observations are consequences of one such process.
view.named_obstruction: Two single-symbol observations are consistent with many inequivalent state-carrying processes; with no query that tells them apart, the account cannot be narrowed to one.

generative_commitment.generator_class_ref: a state-carrying process over the input symbols whose reply to the next symbol depends on the history so far (the declared bounded class)
generative_commitment.prediction_operator: run the recovered candidate process forward from its initial state over an input word, emitting one reply symbol per input symbol
